data.name: Happy Monster
data.detailed_description:
​Game Synopsis​​

​​1.Background​​

A century after the dissipation of human civilization, on a newborn Earth, the stellar civilization of the ​​Shamuron Dragonkin​​ faces catastrophe following the fall of their king. The Demon God leads dark forces in a surprise attack on the dragonkin's home planet, aiming to devour the universe. Deprived of the protection of Draconic Soul power, ​​Shamuron​​ falls abruptly, forcing the scattered dragon tribes into exile. Among them, the ​​Stellar Clan​​, bearing the ember of hope, crash-lands on the newborn Earth, only to find the claws of the Demon God lurking in the shadows.

Players will assume the role of the dragonkin warrior ​​Sartos​​. Amidst safeguarding his newfound home and battling corrupting forces, he will gradually unravel the mystery of the hidden Dragon Crystal and his bloodline's truth. From an exile to the Child of Destiny, he must shoulder the mission to restart the dragonkin civilization, writing his legend on the perilous alien battleground.

​​2. Features​​

Experience combat with limitless possibilities and cathartic horde-clearing thrills through synergistic ​​Skill Chains​​, earth-shattering ​​Dragon Fury Bursts​​, adaptive ​​Devour & Evolution​​, and powerful ​​Relic Abilities​​.

Unlock multiple draconic forms through bloodline evolution, each possessing unique talent trees and ability branches, offering strategic depth and freedom of growth.

Delve into an epic of the dragonkin's rise and fall intertwined with Sartos's personal fate, presented through ​​hand-drawn comic chapters​​.

Confront stylistically diverse ​​Cthulhu-esque bosses​​, devise unique strategies within dynamic environments like plains, swamps, and magma caves, and challenge yourself to clear them all.

​​3. Gameplay​​

Traverse corrupted otherworlds overrun by monsters. Utilize different draconic forms, skill combinations, and devouring absorbed attributes to achieve dynamic growth, becoming stronger the more you fight.

In story stages, master various draconic forms, gradually unlocking combat techniques to tackle changing stage mechanics and environmental interaction challenges.

Utilize stage rewards, and the pre-battle shop's ​​skills, runes, and items​​, alongside the forging functions of ​​reforging, synthesis, and alchemy​​ to construct differentiated combat builds.

In challenge mode, freely choose initial forms and skill combinations, confront Cthulhu-esque bosses across randomized terrains, and push for record clear times.

data.short_description: Happy Monsters is a rogue-lite game themed around dragons and Cthulhu monsters. Players take on the role of the dragonborn warrior Sartos, fighting corruption to protect their homeland while uncovering the mysteries of the world and finding a way to defeat the monsters.

English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
